title: Pi-HOC: Pairwise 3D Human-Object Contact
summary: An instance-aware framework for predicting dense 3D human-object contact from single images. It utilizes the InteractionFormer architecture and a SAM-based decoder to map contact masks onto SMPL human meshes in multi-person scenes.
research_notes: Established new state-of-the-art results on the MMHOI and DAMON datasets, outperforming previous Vision-Language Models like InteractVLM.

evolution.summary: Evolved from the PICO-fit (2025) optimization-based approach to a single-pass transformer model. It introduced 'Referential Contact' allowing for natural language queries and significantly improved inference throughput for large-scale video processing.
